title: International Parliamentary Scholarship (IPS)
description: A five-month scholarship run by the German Bundestag (federal parliament) giving young graduates from partner countries hands-on experience in German parliamentary and political life. The stay in Berlin runs 1 March to 31 July, opening with an introductory language and seminar course before placing each scholar in the office of a Member of the Bundestag as a parliamentary intern. Scholars receive a monthly allowance of EUR 700, free accommodation, reimbursed travel costs to and from Berlin, and health/accident/liability insurance. Applicants must be under 30, hold a completed Bachelor's degree, show social or political engagement, and have at least B2-level German (the program is conducted in German, not English). Applications are submitted through the German embassy or diplomatic mission responsible for the applicant's country, and go through several regional tracks (Europe/Eurasia, the Arab world, Africa, Asia) -- some countries' embassies set an earlier local deadline, so applicants should confirm the exact date with their nearest German mission, but the general application deadline for the 2027 intake (1 March-31 July 2027 stay) is 31 July 2026.
visaNote: German exchange/training visa arranged with support from the local German embassy as part of the scholarship.
